changelog: Universal Android Phone, Tablet, and Android TV / Google TV support in one APK: native LEANBACK_LAUNCHER, 640x360 TV home screen banner, glowing D-Pad focus highlights and card zoom, widescreen top navigation bar for TV and tablets, and complete TV remote playback controls.

Fixed video playback fetching errors and spontaneous timestamp jumps (e.g. 2 min to 1 hour) on tablets, phones, and TVs: lazy LoudnessEnhancer (prevents AudioTrack clock drift), Media3 decoder fallback, broken external-subtitle auto-recovery, BDIX network auto-reconnect + mirror failover, anti-time-jump watchdog, SeekBar setMax fix, and safe # and % URL encoding.

Includes VLC-style 8-mode video size / aspect-ratio fixing with 2-finger pinch-to-zoom, left brightness and right 200% sound boost sliders, silent background auto-sync, and direct in-system APK updates.
